dct_description_sm: Environics Environmental Monitor (EEM) is a public opinion survey of Canadian citizens. The Environmental Monitor is a syndicated quarterly report of Canadian public attitudes toward environmental and natural resource issues. Each quarterly report is based on the results of 1,500 telephone interviews with a representative sample of adult Canadians. Currently, data surveys are available through the Canadian Opinion Research Archive from 1987. Environics Environmental Monitor, 1994-4 is a telephone survey of 1,504 adult Canadians conducted during the period from December 16, 1994 to January 18, 1995.
